# Cytoscape.js

Pinned browser bundle: Cytoscape.js 3.34.3, MIT.

- Upstream: https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js/tree/v3.34.3
- Distribution: `cytoscape@3.34.3`, `dist/cytoscape.min.js` from the npm package.
- SHA-256 (distribution bytes): `5f3b5b529546d5af1fc5628590af033b74511a5b6f789f5f4682845863228b91`.
- Copyright and complete license are retained in the bundle and `CYTOSCAPE-LICENSE.txt`.

The product embeds this standalone bundle as text and serves it from its loopback
server. No CDN or package manager is needed to run the installed workbench.
The vendored bytes are included in the product source hash; updates require a
new build, graph browser checks, and release validation.
